gen-gf-bellota-gf-albert-sans: Distinctive from the first glance, Bellota hangs the ends of its s far from the spine and draws every stroke with one stylus width. Albert Sans keeps its apertures open even at tiny sizes.
gen-gf-bellota-gf-biz-udpgothic: BIZ UDPGothic reads approachable and modern, with lavish letter spacing. Bellota is best as a wire-bent sign of constant thickness, while the sans-serif body is best at leading the eye into each round letter.
gen-gf-bellota-gf-commissioner: Distinctive and commanding, Bellota hangs its s ends far from the spine, and every stroke follows a single stylus width. Commissioner, a smooth sans, reads without any clogged curves.
gen-gf-bellota-gf-dotgothic16: DotGothic16 reads approachable and professional, with wide channels into each counter. Best of all, Bellota's stylus-width strokes and that body's tube-like thickness mean a constant line runs through both fonts.
gen-gf-bellota-gf-el-messiri: Moderate contrast, neither stark nor flat, gives the body its modern look, against Bellota's unvarying line weight. El Messiri also leaves a wide slot between the c's ends, the clearest sign of its openness.
gen-gf-bellota-gf-elms-sans: Commanding up top, Bellota hangs its s ends far from the spine and traces every stroke at a single stylus width. Elms Sans keeps a pressure-free ballpoint line that wears well paragraph after paragraph.
gen-gf-bellota-gf-encode-sans: Encode Sans reads clean and neutral, with gaps that keep c from looking like o. And Bellota's stylus-width line, with no vertical emphasis, lets the plain sans body carry the detail.
gen-gf-bellota-gf-encode-sans-expanded: Bellota hangs the ends of its s far from the spine, every stroke holding a single thickness. And Encode Sans Expanded, with c tips pulled well apart, keeps a neutral, approachable feel as the paragraphs stack up.
gen-gf-bellota-gf-encode-sans-semi-conde: Bellota's s hangs its ends far from the spine, and its strokes carry no calligraphic modulation. Encode Sans Semi Condensed is best at open, approachable counters, while Bellota is best at display.
gen-gf-bellota-gf-encode-sans-semi-expan: Bellota hangs its distinctive s ends far from the spine, every stroke held to one stylus weight. Encode Sans Semi Expanded leaves rounded letters open, a quiet foil for Bellota.
